mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_item (symbol, market, stock_name, image_url, enabled, source, group_key) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{imageUrl}, #{enabled}, #{source}, #{groupKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_item SET stock_name = #{stockName}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, enabled = #{enabled}, source = #{source}, group_key = #{groupKey}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_item WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY CASE group_key WHEN 'holding' THEN 1 WHEN 'watch' THEN 2 WHEN 'candidate' THEN 3 WHEN 'archived' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, gmt_create ASC, id ASC
